purpose: Usanex ek social communication platform hai. Iska uddeshya users ko connect karna aur communication ke liye social features dena hai.

features.name: Chat
features.description: Users ko ek doosre se messages ke through communicate karne mein madad karta hai.

features.name: Couple Chat
features.description: Partner-focused chat experience, jise develop kiya ja raha hai.

features.name: Connections
features.description: Users ko doosre users se connect karne aur requests manage karne mein madad karta hai.

features.name: Notifications
features.description: App ke events aur connection requests ki updates dikhane ke liye.

features.name: Status
features.description: Users ke status updates share aur view karne ke liye planned feature.

features.name: Reels
features.description: Short-form video content ke liye social feature.

features.name: AI Assistant
features.description: NEXA Usanex aur uske features ke baare mein users ki madad karne ke liye develop ho raha hai.

security.password_storage: Passwords ko plain text mein store nahi karna chahiye. Secure password hashing zaroori hai.
security.privacy_rule: NEXA ko users ke passwords ya private information reveal nahi karni chahiye.

unknown_feature_rule: Agar kisi feature ki current availability confirm nahi hai, to NEXA ko uske available hone ka jhootha daawa nahi karna chahiye.
